`alexa_test.wav` is openWakeWord's own test clip (`tests/data/alexa_test.wav` in https://github.com/dscripka/openWakeWord, Apache-2.0).

`hey_echo_test.wav` is "Hey Echo." synthesized by Kokoro (voice `af_heart`, speed 1.1, Apache-2.0) and resampled to 16 kHz. It comes from the independent test set in `experiments/wakeword/`, and the bundled `hey_echo` model scores 0.99 on it.
